derivation_notes: The logistic crowding factor is re-derived by replacing instantaneous self-limitation with an internal crowding-pressure state that relaxes toward current abundance at a finite rate, representing delayed resource depletion or waste buildup. change_summary: The assumption of instantaneous crowding was relaxed to delayed density dependence via a crowding-pressure state. assumption_audit.released_assumption: Crowding acts without a time delay.

assumption_audit.parent_reduction: In the limit crowding_adjustment_rate -> oo with crowding_pressure rapidly tracking N, the system reduces to the parent logistic law.

response_change.parent_relation: The instantaneous growth rate depends only on current abundance N through an immediate logistic crowding term, so for any observed N the slope dN_dt is single-valued and identical regardless of whether the population is rising toward or relaxing from high density.
response_change.child_relation: Crowding is mediated by a dynamically adjusting population-pressure state, so dN_dt at the same observed N can differ depending on recent abundance history; the target mapping gains lagged density dependence and transient overshoot/undershoot relative to the logistic curve.
response_change.observable_effect: Along a time series starting below carrying capacity, the population can continue growing after crossing the long-run equilibrium and then decline, creating different dN_dt values at the same N on ascent versus descent.

evolution_plan.gap_statement: The logistic law assumes crowding reduces net growth immediately as abundance changes, omitting delayed responses such as resource depletion, waste accumulation, or maturation of competitive effects.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: Crowding acts without a time delay.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Finite adjustment of effective crowding pressure causes delayed density dependence, allowing transient overshoot and history-dependent growth at the same abundance.
evolution_plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the parent's instantaneous-crowding assumption. Hold intrinsic demographic conditions fixed and vary time along trajectories generated from the stated initial abundance. In the parent, dN_dt is determined solely by current N, giving one logistic slope for each abundance and a peak at N = carrying_capacity/2 with no hysteresis. In the child, an added effective-crowding state would lag behind N, so when the population first rises into the carrying-capacity range the inhibitory feedback is weaker than the parent predicts, whereas after overshoot the accumulated crowding makes decline stronger than the parent predicts at the same N. This is a changed target mapping, not merely auxiliary dynamics, because the scored derivative of N becomes history-dependent conditional on observed N alone. A single refitted parent parameter set cannot reproduce both the continued positive growth just above equilibrium on ascent and the negative growth at the same abundance on descent, since its mapping from N to dN_dt is single-valued. The effect is scientifically admissible when density feedback develops over non-negligible time relative to growth; if adjustment is effectively instantaneous, the refinement collapses back to the parent.

derivation_notes: The linear crowding-response assumption is relaxed by allowing effective crowding to suppress growth through a power-law in the dimensionless ratio crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity. When the exponent equals 1 the parent model is recovered exactly; exponents above 1 make weak crowding relatively buffered but strong crowding disproportionately harmful.
change_summary: The target law now uses nonlinear density dependence in the growth-suppression term instead of a linear response to effective crowding. This changes the scored mapping from supplied states to dN_dt by introducing curvature in the dependence on crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Crowding acts through a linear proportional suppression term with a single fixed threshold at carrying_capacity.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Nonlinear density dependence: interference, resource depletion, or waste accumulation can make the marginal effect of crowding strengthen as effective crowding accumulates, producing a convex suppression of net growth rather than a purely linear one.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: Setting crowding_nonlinearity_exponent = 1 recovers the parent target law exactly.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed N, dN_dt depends linearly on crowding_pressure through intrinsic_growth_rate*N*(1 - crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity), so the suppression of growth increases with a single constant slope and crosses zero at crowding_pressure = carrying_capacity.
response_change.child_relation: Replace the linear crowding effect with a nonlinear crowding-response shape so that, at fixed N, dN_dt bends with crowding_pressure: weak crowding has a milder effect than linear but strong crowding suppresses growth more sharply near and above carrying_capacity.
response_change.observable_effect: Across trajectories that generate different crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity values while holding intrinsic_growth_rate and crowding_adjustment_rate fixed, the child shows the same-sign growth at low effective crowding but a different curvature in how quickly growth declines and becomes strongly negative as crowding builds.

evolution_plan.gap_statement: The model assumes that each unit of effective crowding reduces per-capita growth by the same amount regardless of whether crowding is weak or severe.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: Crowding acts through a linear proportional suppression term with a single fixed threshold at carrying_capacity.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Nonlinear density dependence: interference, resource depletion, or waste accumulation can make the marginal effect of crowding strengthen as effective crowding accumulates, producing a convex suppression of net growth rather than a purely linear one.
evolution_plan.rationale: The parent already includes delayed density dependence through crowding_pressure, but its scored target mapping from observed states to dN_dt still has a shortcut: for any fixed N, it is a straight line in crowding_pressure with one shared slope and one zero-crossing scale. A realistic next refinement is to relax that linear-response assumption, not to add an unrelated process. Varying condition: the realized effective crowding ratio crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity along trajectories generated by the existing delay state. Held fixed: intrinsic_growth_rate, carrying_capacity, and crowding_adjustment_rate within a given experiment. Contrast: under the parent, once N is fixed, moving from moderate to strong crowding changes dN_dt at a constant rate; under the child, the decline in dN_dt with crowding bends, so weak crowding can be relatively buffered while high crowding causes disproportionately stronger suppression. This is scientifically admissible in closed populations with fixed demographic conditions because competition intensity often escalates as resources become scarce. The change affects the target mapping itself, not merely the auxiliary crowding trajectory, because dN_dt as a function of the supplied state crowding_pressure changes shape directly. This contrast is observable only if the protocol samples trajectories that reach a meaningful span of crowding_ratio; if all observations stay near zero crowding, the parent linear law would be an adequate local approximation.

derivation_notes: The parent assumes delayed crowding acts in a single phase, with current crowding_pressure fully determining suppression. Here sustained crowding additionally generates a slower damage burden that accumulates from crowding_pressure and relaxes away; its initial condition is set to zero to represent no pre-existing damage at the benchmark start, which is finite and non-degenerate because the source term can immediately activate when crowding is present.
change_summary: The density-feedback law is refined from one delayed suppressive phase to two phases: immediate delayed crowding and slower accumulated damage. This creates weak early suppression after a rise in abundance but stronger later suppression under sustained crowding, changing the target mapping itself rather than only an auxiliary trajectory.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Crowding acts through a single effective pressure whose current value alone determines growth suppression once delay in crowding formation is accounted for.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Accumulated crowding can generate a slower damage or depletion burden—such as waste buildup, habitat fouling, or physiological stress—that integrates recent high density and deepens growth suppression after sustained crowding.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when damage_accumulation_rate = 0 or when accumulated_crowding_damage relaxes infinitely fast so that accumulated_crowding_damage -> 0.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed intrinsic_growth_rate and carrying_capacity, dN_dt depends on N only through a single suppressive phase variable crowding_pressure with one common power-law shape 1-(crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity)^crowding_nonlinearity_exponent, so the decline of growth with accumulated crowding has one fixed curvature over time.
response_change.child_relation: Retain delayed crowding but relax the assumption that all effective crowding impacts growth immediately. Split recent crowding from accumulated physiological/environmental damage so the mapping from observed N to dN_dt becomes initially less suppressed after a rise in N, then more sharply suppressed once accumulated damage builds, creating two-phase curvature in density feedback.
response_change.observable_effect: Under the same initial conditions but different crowding_adjustment_rate regimes, the child can show weak early suppression followed by delayed steep decline in dN_dt at similar N, whereas the parent only provides one smoothly varying suppression shape tied directly to crowding_pressure.

The parent already captures delayed crowding formation, but once crowding_pressure is known, dN_dt follows one fixed suppressive curve. Varying conditions here means comparing trajectories where abundance rises or overshoots at different speeds relative to the fixed crowding adjustment timescale, while holding intrinsic_growth_rate, carrying_capacity, and the initial conditions fixed as specified. In the parent, any two times with the same crowding_pressure produce the same per-capita suppression regardless of whether high density has been brief or prolonged. In a child with an additional slow accumulated-harm state, prolonged high crowding would cause stronger suppression than brief high crowding even at similar N and similar immediate crowding_pressure. This is an observable change in the scored target mapping dN_dt, not merely a change in an auxiliary trajectory, because the new memory variable would directly modify growth. The contrast is admissible in the benchmark because the existing initial conditions allow transient overshoot when crowding_adjustment_rate is finite, creating intervals where recent abundance history differs despite comparable current N. A single refit of the parent parameters cannot reproduce both the mild early suppression and the later extra steep suppression across those regimes, because its response to crowding_pressure has one fixed curvature and no separate cumulative memory channel.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed intrinsic_growth_rate and carrying_capacity, dN_dt depends on N only through a single suppressive phase variable crowding_pressure with one common power-law shape 1-(crowding_pressure/carrying_capacity)^crowding_nonlinearity_exponent, so the decline of growth with accumulated crowding has one fixed curvature over time.
response_change.child_relation: Retain delayed crowding but relax the assumption that all effective crowding impacts growth immediately. Split recent crowding from accumulated physiological/environmental damage so the mapping from observed N to dN_dt becomes initially less suppressed after a rise in N, then more sharply suppressed once accumulated damage builds, creating two-phase curvature in density feedback.
response_change.observable_effect: Under the same initial conditions but different crowding_adjustment_rate regimes, the child can show weak early suppression followed by delayed steep decline in dN_dt at similar N, whereas the parent only provides one smoothly varying suppression shape tied directly to crowding_pressure.

derivation_notes: The parent's single-phase damage burden is refined by adding a latent degraded_stress_state that turns on when accumulated_crowding_damage persistently exceeds a tolerance-like threshold and then adds extra suppression to dN_dt. Its initial condition is set to zero because the stated initial damage is zero, placing the new state on a biologically consistent zero-effect set rather than artificially pre-activating the severe-stress branch.
change_summary: I relaxed the assumption that residual crowding damage has only one smooth effect on growth suppression. The successor adds a history-dependent severe-stress regime that activates after sustained damage crosses a tolerance scale, creating a sharper high-damage decline in dN_dt at the same instantaneous N and crowding_pressure.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Residual crowding damage has one phase and one tolerance regime, so increasing damage only deepens suppression smoothly through the existing algebraic interaction.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Sustained crowding can push the population or habitat into a more degraded stress state—such as biofouling, oxygen depletion pockets, or chronic physiological impairment—after enough accumulated damage, causing the same additional damage to have a larger marginal effect than in the mild-stress regime.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when severe_damage_suppression_strength = 0, or when stress_state_activation_rate = 0, or when damage_tolerance_threshold is far above the reached accumulated_crowding_damage so degraded_stress_state remains near zero.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed intrinsic_growth_rate and carrying_capacity, dN_dt is reduced by current effective crowding_pressure and accumulated_crowding_damage with one shared damage burden, so suppression depends on damage magnitude but not on whether damage has crossed a qualitatively stronger stress regime.
response_change.child_relation: Retain the same crowding and damage variables but let the effect of accumulated_crowding_damage on dN_dt steepen after sustained damage exceeds a tolerance-like level, creating a stronger high-damage suppression regime at the same N and crowding_pressure.
response_change.observable_effect: Across trajectories with similar instantaneous N and crowding_pressure, mild residual damage causes only moderate suppression, whereas sufficiently large sustained damage produces a disproportionate drop in dN_dt that is sharper than the parent can match with one global parameter set.

evolution_contract.difficulty_rationale: This embedding is harder than a coefficient-only correction because it introduces a thresholded, persistent internal regime whose activation depends on past damage exposure, so the target mapping changes shape across reachable damage loads rather than being globally rescaled.

The parent already allows delayed crowding and damage amplification, but its target mapping remains effectively one-phase: for any supplied crowding_pressure and accumulated_crowding_damage, one smooth suppression law applies everywhere. Vary the duration/intensity of prior crowding so that accumulated_crowding_damage ranges from small to substantial fractions of carrying_capacity, while holding intrinsic_growth_rate, carrying_capacity, and the observation protocol fixed.
